# Bevy 0.20.1 logged them ("processing shader ..., with shader defs [...]", `bevy_shader=debug`)
# in a native region tour of the Himalayas (Task 11c fix round 4, 2026-11-27): one line per
# pipeline variant, the shader file then the defs. Read by `tests/shader_compile.rs`. Refresh
# with a debug-logged run when Bevy or a material's pipeline key changes.
